{{Wireless adapter |brand=BT |model=Wi-Fi Dongle 300 |revision=(075714) |upc= |ean=5016351515150 |asin=B00D84GVF8;GB; |price=38 |est_release_date=07/2013 |fcc_date= |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability=EoL |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=dongle |vendor_id=0a5c |device_id=43a0 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id= |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM43235;BCM43235KMLG; |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui= |lin_driver=[[brcmfmac]] (after runtime device ID insertion) |win_driver= }} {{TagLine|BT Wi-Fi Dongle 300}} (P/N: 075714) :[http://bt.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/45436/ Support page] :[http://bt.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/45466/c/1243/ Drivers] [http://www.shop.bt.com/products/bt-wi-fi-dongle-300-8W44.html On '''shop.bt.com'''] :[http://www.shop.bt.com/content/uni2/documentation/8w44/wi-fi_dongle_300_data_sheet_v1.1.pdf Datasheet] '''Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics''' is the presumed manufacturer of this dongle (they make BT's other two newer dongles). The drivers on the '''Windows Update''' ([http://catalog.update.microsoft.com/v7/site/ScopedViewRedirect.aspx?updateid=b78e6df7-da7c-4152-957a-22643f3d4123 WinXP drivers]) site seem to indicate the probable USB ID for the device is 0a5c:43a0. It is the only ID labeled as '''BT Wi-Fi Dongle''' in the driver set (the rest are labeled as '''BT Dual-Band Wi-Fi Dongle'''). Additional specifications, per '''BT''''s datasheet, follow... *Weight: [[Weight::12.5 g]] *Dimension:: [[Dimensions::80 mm x 28 mm x 9 mm]] *Giftbox barcode: 5016351515150 *Overpack (40x Giftbox) barcode: 05016351822258 === Get this baby running with brcmfmac / Linux support === 
1. /lib/firmware/brcm/brcmfmac43236b.bin
2. lsusb | grep Broadcom
   Bus 001 Device 035: ID 0a5c:43a0 Broadcom Corp.
3. modprobe brcmfmac
4. echo 0a5c 43a0 > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/brcmfmac/new_id
5. dmesg
[] usb 1-1.4: new high-speed USB device number 35 using ehci-pci
[] usb 1-1.4: New USB device found, idVendor=0a5c, idProduct=43a0
[] usb 1-1.4: New USB device strings: Mfr=1, Product=2, SerialNumber=3
[] usb 1-1.4: Product: Remote Download Wireless Adapter
[] usb 1-1.4: Manufacturer: Broadcom
[] usb 1-1.4: SerialNumber: 000000000001
[] usbcore: registered new interface driver brcmfmac
[] usb 1-1.4: firmware: direct-loading firmware brcm/brcmfmac43236b.bin
[] brcmfmac: brcmf_c_preinit_dcmds: 
   Firmware version = wl0: Nov 30 2011 17:33:42 version 5.90.188.22
[] usb 1-1.4 wlan13: renamed from wlan1
